# Air quality (`air-quality`)

A reading (CO₂, particles, VOC) on a good-to-poor band with its level word and a short trend.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createAirQuality` (types in `dist/web/home/climate-energy/airQuality.d.ts`): `.mh-air-quality`: one air reading (carbon dioxide, particles, volatile compounds or any other) with its level word on a good-to-poor band and the direction of the last readings. Level colours come from the status roles.

```ts
export function createAirQuality(options: AirQualityOptions): AirQualityHandle;

export interface AirQualityOptions {
  /** Default `other`. */
  kind?: AirQualityKind;
  /** What is shown ("Carbon dioxide"); default the kind's name. */
  name?: string;
  value: number | null;
  /** Default the kind's unit. */
  unit?: string;
  /** Default the kind's bands; required for `other`. */
  bands?: AirQualityBands;
  /** Recent readings, oldest first, ending now: drawn as a small line with the direction in words. */
  trend?: readonly (number | null)[];
  /** The span of the trend ("Last 6 hours"), after the direction. */
  trendLabel?: string;
  /** Smaller, for watches and small tiles: the band and line stay, the reading gets smaller. */
  compact?: boolean;
  /** Formats the reading (default whole numbers, one decimal below 10). */
  format?: (value: number) => string;
  labels?: Partial<AirQualityLabels>;
}

export interface AirQualityHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  /** Replaces everything shown. */
  update(options: AirQualityOptions): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface AirQualityLabels {
  good: string;
  moderate: string;
  poor: string;
  'very-poor': string;
  rising: string;
  falling: string;
  steady: string;
  noData: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createAirQuality } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const air = createAirQuality({
  kind: 'co2',
  value: 640,
  // Oldest first, ending with the reading now.
  trend: [520, 560, 600, 610, 640],
  trendLabel: 'Last 2 hours',
});

document.body.append(air.el);
```
